Digital & Data Analyst (12 months)
About us
Exampla Pharma is a leading European specialist pharmaceutical company. Exampla Pharma has been bringing medicines to patients for over 100 years.
In this role, you will turn operational data into actionable insight and help develop digital, automation and AI-enabled solutions. Your work will strengthen decision-making, efficiency and continuous improvement within a regulated manufacturing environment.
Your responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards and reports for manufacturing performance (OEE, deviations, batch release)
- Support feasibility studies and recommend appropriate technical developments.
- Drive continuous improvement projects using data analysis and process improvement methods
- Develop automation solutions with Power BI, Power Automate and Python
You will bring:
- Experience applying data, reporting, process improvement and digital technologies in a regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical, life sciences or operational environment
- Strong business intelligence, data analysis and performance-improvement capabilities
- Experience with Power BI and SQL
- Knowledge of GMP is an advantage
- Fluent English; German is a plus
Our values
Drive: Take ownership, focus on the priorities that matter and deliver meaningful operational improvements
This is a 12 Months Fixed Term Contract role.
